author: Tekcrezec162
body:
^Title says it
Nebula is lacking in its DTM aspect now.
Maps such as ClayTDM is literally nexus now,I don't see the point of having a kill-point system for Nebula if it's meant to be a DTM game.
I don't think maps like ClayTDM should be included in Nebula as it defeats the purpose of it being a DTM game,it should be moved to Nexus or another gamemode but not DTM Nebula.

title: Nebula not living up to it's name?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Top shown: DTM
Bottom shown: TDM
Now, 6 of those TDM maps are currently in rotations, rest for testing. The DTM maps are full of stock, and when Nebula was out in MCZone it also included TDM. Team Deathmatch is more based around kills than the general monument match would be. However, the thing is not one person really ever said Nebula was mainly for monuments anyway. Maps like ClayTDM aren't close to nexus which have kits, which the nebula TDM does not. Besides, why can't we have both?

replies.body: Nebula isn't specific for destroying/capturing monuments though. Also, what makes nexus different from a TDM is the kits and why it should be in nebula. It certainly should still be here, but not be a separate gamemode. Where else would it be?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
You're welcome to place any feedback you have of maps in a thread, just don't be too harsh. It'd be nice if you listed it like something along the lines of

Periculum - Too chaotic, lots of spawnkilling, flat
ClayTDM - Laggy, flat, hard navigation

but try to list positives as well.
